info.description: Mmereko's partner API for UniversityFlow (docs/integrations/universityflow-partner-api.md). OAuth 2.0 client credentials; every write carries learnerRef and consent; errors are RFC 9457 problems that never echo a submitted value. Webhooks: POST to the partner's URL with x-mmereko-signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.mmereko.<body>">.
